blocks.title: An incomplete traffic light
blocks.source:
Enum Semaforo
  Rojo, Ambar, Verde
EndEnum
Algorithm Cruce
  Define luz As Semaforo <- Semaforo.Ambar;
  Switch luz Do
    Semaforo.Rojo:
      Write "Para";
    Semaforo.Verde:
      Write "Pasa";
  EndSwitch
EndAlgorithm

runs.text: The message names the missing members, in the order they were declared.

blocks.title: A repeated label
A text selector
blocks.source:
Algorithm TextoSel
  Define t As String <- "a";
  Switch t Do
    "a":
      Write "a";
  EndSwitch
EndAlgorithm

With enumerations, the branches must cover every member.
